settings.name: USE_CUSTOM_SSL
settings.description: **Enable Custom SSL:** Set to `yes` to use your own certificate instead of the auto-generated one.

settings.name: CUSTOM_SSL_CERT_PRIORITY
settings.description: **Certificate Priority:** Choose whether to prioritize the certificate from file path or from base64 data (`file` or `data`).

settings.name: CUSTOM_SSL_CERT
settings.description: **Certificate Path:** Full path to your SSL certificate or certificate bundle file.

settings.name: CUSTOM_SSL_KEY
settings.description: **Private Key Path:** Full path to your SSL private key file.

settings.name: CUSTOM_SSL_CERT_DATA
settings.description: **Certificate Data:** Your certificate encoded in base64 format or as plaintext PEM.

settings.name: CUSTOM_SSL_KEY_DATA
settings.description: **Private Key Data:** Your private key encoded in base64 format or as plaintext PEM.
